question: Which Chief Minister made an announcement regarding the issuance of Kunbi certificates to old Maratha Kunbis in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eknath Shinde**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eknath Shinde** is the Chief Minister who announced the issuance of** Kunbi certificates to old Maratha Kunbis in 2023**.
 
• The decision aims to provide the Maratha Kunbis with the necessary certification, which can help them avail of certain benefits and **reservations**.
 
• Eknath Shinde is the current **Chief Minister **of **Maharashtra**.
 
• This move is part of the broader effort to address the demands and needs of the Maratha community in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eknath Shinde** assumed office as the Chief Minister of Maharashtra in 2022.
 
• The Maratha community has been seeking recognition and benefits similar to those provided to other backward classes.
 
• Issuance of Kunbi certificates is expected to facilitate access to **educational and employment opportunities for the Maratha Kunbis**.
 
• This initiative reflects the government's commitment to addressing the socio-economic issues faced by the Maratha community.
